title: Investigating Laser and Plasma-Focused Ion Beam Interactions for Precise Material Modification in Energy Technologies
content: Emerging ultrafast laser ablation and plasma focused ion beam (PFIB) scanning electron microscopy (SEM) techniques [1, 2] offer powerful capabilities for precise material analysis and modification, making it an essential tool for advancing energy technologies [3, 4]. However, understanding how materials interact with femtosecond laser irradiation and plasma-focused ion beams remains a complex challenge. This work highlights our investigation in laser-material and plasma-FIB-material interactions and how insights from this research will inform the development of adaptive control systems to enhance material processing.
